items.q: Do I need to know about computers?
items.a: No. There are no menus or buttons to learn: you talk to it and it answers. And if you would rather not set it up yourself, we set it up for you.

items.q: What do I need to use it?
items.a: A Windows or Mac computer, an internet connection and a paid Claude account, the AI assistant you talk to. If you handle personal data, Claude Team or Enterprise.

items.q: Do my documents leave my computer?
items.a: Your brain and your documents are kept on your computers, and Pymatic Labs never receives them. But what Claude reads to answer you does leave: it goes to Anthropic, the company behind Claude, and stays in your Claude history until you delete it. During setup we show you how to turn off its training and its memory.

items.q: What if it gets something wrong?
items.a: It tells you which document each answer comes from, so you can check. If something has changed, tell it and it offers to correct it. And if it does not know, it says so.

items.q: Do I have to pay every month?
items.a: No. You pay once and the license is for good. The monthly plan is optional (improvements and support) and, if you drop it, the brain keeps working.

items.q: Can it mess up my folders?
items.a: No. It only reads your company folder. When it tidies up, it makes a separate copy and your folders stay as they are.

security.subtitle: What happens to your information and how to report a flaw to us.
behind: The brain’s content and the passwords live on your computers. Pymatic Labs does not receive them.
What the assistant reads travels to Anthropic, the company behind Claude, and stays in your Claude history until you delete it.
With Claude Team or Enterprise, Anthropic does not train on that data, by contract, and Claude’s memory comes off.
With Claude Pro or Max, memory comes on and training is decided in Claude’s privacy settings. That is why during setup we show you how to turn both off.
security.behindNote: Setup cannot check those Claude settings. Anthropic also sets two exceptions: response ratings you send it and whatever its safety filters flag.

also: Your originals are never modified: the brain only reads them.
Nothing is installed or connected without your permission.
The license is checked on your computer, offline: there is no remote kill switch.

errors.eu_no_vat_limit: Right now you cannot subscribe to the monthly plan with Spanish VAT: we have reached the yearly limit for sales to companies in other EU countries without a VAT number. Write to info@pymaticlabs.com and we will sort it out.

statuses.active: Active: charged in advance, monthly or yearly depending on what you chose, and renewed automatically until you cancel.
statuses.trialing: Not charged yet: the first charge comes when the months included in your purchase end.
statuses.past_due: A charge is unpaid: we have emailed you about it. Check your card in the Stripe portal. For 15 days after that email you keep maintenance and support, new versions included; if it is still unpaid by then, they are suspended.
statuses.unpaid: Some charges are unpaid and maintenance and support are suspended. Pay what is pending or change your card in the Stripe portal to continue; your license and what you installed keep working.

monthly.licenseUntil: Paid until {date}. Each charge brings a new license with the new date, here in the area.
monthly.included: Your purchase includes maintenance and support until {date}.
monthly.includedNext: To continue afterwards, subscribe to the monthly plan: as your included months are ending now, it is charged from the day you subscribe.
monthly.includedNextPlan: To continue afterwards, subscribe to the monthly plan: with the {plan} plan or a smaller one, paid monthly or yearly, nothing is charged until {date}; with a bigger one, it is charged from the day you subscribe.
monthly.none: You have no maintenance or support right now.
monthly.noneText: Your license is still valid and what you installed keeps working. With the monthly plan you get new versions with what is new switched on again, and support.
monthly.portal: Change card or plan, or cancel
monthly.portalNote: This opens the Stripe customer portal, which handles the payments. There you can also switch between monthly and yearly payment: moving to yearly payment or a bigger plan is charged that day; moving to a smaller plan or back to monthly payment, when the paid period ends. While you have included months left, no change is charged before they end. When you are done, you come back here.
monthly.securityTitle: Security does not depend on the monthly plan
monthly.security: Security fixes reach every customer for free during their version’s support period: five years from its release.
monthly.plansText: Monthly, or yearly in advance for the price of 10 months. Pressing a button takes you to the Stripe payment, with your company already filled in.
monthly.plansClosed: Online subscription opens soon. In the meantime, write to us at info@pymaticlabs.com.
monthly.yearly: or {price} a year, excl. VAT: the price of 10 months

team.title: Your team
team.intro: With your team license, up to {seats} people can sign in, including you. Each one signs in with their email and a code, like you, and downloads the extension. They do not see the invoices or the team.
team.memberNote: The person who bought manages the team. If someone else needs to sign in, ask them.
team.solo: Your license is for one person. For more people to use it, you move to the team license by paying the difference: write to us at info@pymaticlabs.com.
team.how: When you add someone, they get an email with the link to the area. When you remove them, they can no longer sign in, straight away.

sessions.notGuided: Setup sessions come with Guided: Duo and Orchestra. To get them, move to Guided by paying the difference: write to us at info@pymaticlabs.com.
